name: Search and open product details
description: Verifies the main discovery workflow opens a detailed product view with price history and store offers.
steps: Enter Samsung S25 Ultra in the main search field
Press Подробнее on the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB card
Review the product detail modal and browser hash
expected: The Samsung product detail opens with demo price history, offers from 220.lv, Dateks.lv and Samsung.lv, and the URL hash identifies the product.

name: Enable and persist a price alert
description: Verifies a user can enable a demo price-drop alert and the choice survives reload.
steps: Open details for Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB
expected: The product detail remains addressable by its hash and the alert button shows that the notification is enabled after refresh.

name: Filter by store and maximum price
description: Verifies the catalog can be narrowed by merchant and maximum price and restored with reset.
steps: Select Samsung.lv in the store filter
Lower the maximum price below 1500 euros
expected: Products outside the selected store or price ceiling disappear, and reset restores the full catalog.

name: Limit comparison to three products
description: Verifies comparison accepts three products, rejects a fourth, and preserves the selected comparison set.
steps: Add three different products to comparison
Try to add a fourth product
expected: The comparison counter remains 3/3, a visible message says the maximum is three products, and the same three comparison items remain after refresh.

name: Switch language and use product details on mobile
description: Verifies the Latvian interface and product details remain usable on a phone-sized viewport.
steps: Tap LV in the language switch
Review and close the product detail sheet
expected: The interface is in Latvian, the detail sheet is readable without horizontal overflow, and it can be closed.
